data.title: 红莲 · 繁华都市街头并肩漫步
data.description: 华灯初上的都市步行街，换上现代干练便服的红莲与你并肩漫步。两人共享同一副有线耳机听着欢快的旋律，红莲好奇又俏皮地歪头看着你，十指紧扣不放。
data.location: vibrant pedestrian shopping street at twilight
data.action: sharing wired earphones while walking side by side, tilted head with curious smile, interlocking fingers, city neon bokeh
data.lighting: colorful city neon bokeh and soft twilight ambient glow
data.mood: sweet urban date, lighthearted affection, tender curiosity
data.promptProse: Walking side by side in city twilight, Scarlet shares earphones with her partner while holding hands tightly with a bright curious smile.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet sharing wired earphones on a lively city street at dusk.
